result.summary: The page is generally well-designed, but several cards in horizontal carousels are cut off at screen edges, and there are minor contrast and spacing concerns. No critical breakages found.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel cuts off the third card ('Trattoria Piccola') at the right edge, truncating its name and image with no visible affordance that it scrolls
issues.suggestion: Ensure partial card visibility is intentional with a subtle peek, add scroll indicators, or adjust card widths so truncated content isn't ambiguous

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card at the bottom of 'Popular right now' is cut off mid-image with its title, rating, and delivery info not visible, giving an incomplete appearance
issues.suggestion: Ensure the card scrolls into full view or that the truncated state is clearly scrollable; verify bottom padding above the navigation bar

issues.description: The category filter chips (Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, etc.) are also cut off at the right edge with a partially visible chip
issues.suggestion: Confirm horizontal scroll intent; consider fading the edge or adding a scroll hint so users know more categories exist

issues.description: Placeholder text 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' in the search field has relatively low contrast gray-on-light-gray
issues.suggestion: Increase placeholder text contrast while keeping it visually distinct from entered text

issues.description: The delivery-fee badges (e.g., '15-25 min', '-20%') overlap the images with white pill backgrounds; on light images like the poké bowl, contrast of the white badge is weak
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle shadow or semi-transparent dark border behind white badges to keep them legible over light imagery
